effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` rUSD to the vault, using the rUSD allowance the signer gave the vault.
The vault mints steakRUSD shares to `receiver`. The share count comes from the vault's total assets and supply after fee accrual. The calldata has no minimum.
The vault supplies the rUSD to Morpho Blue markets. This does not move any of the signer's assets.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the rUSD amount, the steakRUSD ticker as a raw constant, and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many steakRUSD shares the receiver gets; the calldata has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` The descriptor shows only 'Share ticker: steakRUSD'. In case 0 the signer receives 9270.61 steakRUSD, and no field shows this amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show a value computed from storage. Keep the 'Send shares to' field.

findings.title: deposit spends the signer's rUSD allowance to the vault, and nothing on the screen says so.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);` In case 0 the rUSD allowance to the vault drops to 0 (approval effect, signer 'grant'). The screen shows only 'Deposit asset 10000 rUSD'.
findings.fix: No change needed. Spending the allowance is the prerequisite of the stated deposit.

findings.title: deposit labels the amount 'Deposit asset' and adds a raw 'Share ticker' line without a share amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit fields: `"label": "Deposit asset"` on `assets` with tokenAmount, and `{"label": "Share ticker", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}`. In case 0 the reader was unsure how many shares arrive.
findings.fix: Rename the first label to 'Amount to deposit'. Rename 'Share ticker' to 'Receive shares of' or drop it. Change the intent to 'Deposit rUSD for steakRUSD'.

cases.notes: The screen states the 10000 rUSD out correctly. For the 9270.61 steakRUSD in, it shows only the ticker and the recipient. Nothing states the allowance spent.

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` steakRUSD to `receiver`.
The signer sends rUSD to the vault. The amount is computed from storage with Ceil rounding, using the signer's allowance. The calldata has no maximum.
The vault supplies the rUSD to Morpho Blue.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', the 'Deposit asset' ticker rUSD with no amount, the minted share amount, and the share recipient.

findings.title: mint does not show how much rUSD the signer pays; the amount comes from storage with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` then ERC4626._deposit `safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)`. In case 0... rather case 1, the signer pays 1084166370 wei rUSD, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: rUSD'.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the computed amount. Keep the rUSD field and label it 'Pay with'.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays rUSD. The field shows only a ticker.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: `"intent": "Mint"`, field `{"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}`. In case 1 the reader was unsure how much rUSD leaves.
findings.fix: Change the intent to 'Mint steakRUSD by paying rUSD'. Rename the field to 'Pay with'.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns steakRUSD shares from `owner`. The amount is computed with Ceil rounding and has no maximum in the calldata.
If the signer is not `owner`, the call spends `owner`'s share allowance to the signer.
The vault sends exactly `assets` rUSD to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', the exact rUSD amount, the recipient and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many steakRUSD shares the owner burns; the calldata has no maximum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` and ERC4626._withdraw `_burn(owner, shares);`. No field states the burned shares.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show a value computed from storage.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` steakRUSD from `owner`. If the signer is not `owner`, this spends `owner`'s allowance to the signer.
The vault sends rUSD to `receiver`. The amount is computed from storage with Floor rounding. The calldata has no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', the steakRUSD shares to redeem, the recipient and the owner. The screen does not name the asset received.

findings.title: redeem never names rUSD as the asset received. The mint format shows that constant.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` The redeem fields are only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. In case 2 the signer receives 9.0070 rUSD, and the reader only guessed the asset was rUSD.
findings.fix: Add `{"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}`. Change the intent to 'Redeem steakRUSD for rUSD'.

findings.title: redeem does not show how much rUSD arrives; the calldata has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. In case 2 the signer receives 9006961590539552255 wei rUSD, and no field shows this amount.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show a value computed from storage.

cases.notes: The screen states the 8.2466 steakRUSD out correctly. The rUSD in has no asset name and no amount.
